        # Use a max heap to keep track of the current values of the k elements
        # We'll use negative values for max heap
        import heapq
        heap = [0] * k
        heapq.heapify(heap)
        
        # Process each bit position from high to low (31 down to 0)
        for bit in range(31, -1, -1):
            # For each of the bit_count[bit] bits at this position
            for _ in range(bit_count[bit]):

                max_val = -heapq.heappop(heap)

                new_val = max_val | (1 << bit)
                # Push back the new value
